title: Alloy Director V1 event contracts
description: Stable local event contracts for the Alloy Director, independent of any delivery adapter (SSE today; WebSocket, mobile, or push adapters may be added later without changing these shapes). Events are produced by buildEvent() in scripts/local-dev/lib/director.mjs and validated by validateEvent().

fields.type: One of the declared event types.
fields.initiative_key: Canonical initiative/mission key (^[a-z0-9]+([_-][a-z0-9]+)*$); empty string only for the SSE hello frame.
fields.occurred_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp supplied by the emitter, or null. Pure projections never read the wall clock; the emitter injects time so events stay replayable.
fields.data: Type-specific object (free-form per type; recommended fields listed below).
fields.id: Deterministic 16-hex-char id = sha256(type|initiative_key|occurred_at|stableStringify(data)). Replaying identical state yields the identical id.

mission.started.description: An eligible mission became the single active mission and execution began (legal approved -> assigning transition).

worker.completed.description: A worker reported a terminal, non-failed result for its task.

mission.blocked.description: A mission entered a blocked state, was paused, or is held by an open blocking decision.

decision.required.description: A human decision must be resolved before eligible execution can continue.

qa.ready.description: A mission reached a QA-ready posture with evidence available for review.

release.ready.description: A mission passed QA approval and awaits explicit human release approval (never auto-approved).

mission.failed.description: A mission reached an unrecoverable failed posture.
